title: Malicious code in requestcatcher-pinger-v2 (npm)
description: The npm package 'requestcatcher-pinger-v2' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee full remediation due to potential persistent malicious software.
